## Symbols and notation

| Symbol / abbreviation | Meaning |
|---|---|
| G1–G7 | Checks of the CatBoost tree-objective acceptance (Section 8 of the specification) |
| K | Daily review budget of the V1 objective: round(0.02 × V1 rows / V1 days), at least 1 |
| V1 | Validation 1 (here the synthetic early-stopping partition) |
| `od_wait` | CatBoost's overfitting-detector wait (rounds without improvement) |
| Numerator | Frauds inside the daily review queues after a round (the objective is numerator / frauds) |
| MiB | Mebibyte (2^20 bytes) |
| GPU | Graphics processing unit |
| SHA-256 | Secure Hash Algorithm, 256-bit |
